Name: Reasonable Food Sell Prices
Author: Boolyman
Description:
[size=4][center]Ever wonder why cooked meals in Stardew Valley sell for less than the cost to make them?  This small mod changes the sell price of cooked meals to be slightly higher than the cost of their ingredients.  Now you have a reason to put your cooking skill to work for you!

Most meals are priced at about the cost of their ingredients, plus 10% for chef's labor.
Details below.[/center]
[/size]

[size=3][b][u]The prices for each meal were fairly calculated:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Ingredients with quality, like crops, were calculated using their Gold quality sell prices (give or take).[/size]
[*][size=3]Ingredients that can be regularly purchased in a shop for less than the cost of their crop (like sugar) were calculated using the lower of the two values.[/size]
[*][size=3]Meals that can be regularly purchased from a vendor for less than the cost of their ingredients (like Ice Cream) were left out to avoid exploitation.[/size]
[*][size=3]Meals that already sell for more than the cost of their ingredients were left out (like Algae Soup).[/size]
[/list]

Each meal's price change can be toggled on or off with [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (All price changes are turned on by default).

[b][u]Installation[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] if you want the option to toggle price changes.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip this mod file into your Stardew Valley Mods folder[/size]
[/list][/size]
